load_images_with_retry: load a list of images from file paths with automatic retry on failure using cv2 or pytorch backend
sample_video_frame_sequence: generate a list of sampled frame indices from a video clip given a center index and sample rate
spatially_sample_video_frames: perform spatial sampling on video frames with random scale jitter, crop, and horizontal flip augmentation
normalize_tensor: normalize a PyTorch tensor by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation for model input
load_image_lists_from_file: load image paths and labels from a frame list file into a dictionary or list format
